game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane, a lane of furriers: the sled courier must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Countdown Recursion: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane: a lane of furriers
core_gameplay_loop: In Furrier Lane, repeat each round: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case. Each round, icicle bats strike the ice mill, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the base_case value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ice mill from icicle bats in Furrier Lane: keep the base_case meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: base_case drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Countdown Recursion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Countdown Recursion' (Week 6 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Furrier Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how base_case changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Furrier Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 29 seconds while base_case > 0.
